field.name: project_id
field.label: COM_JOOMLEAGUE_BRACKET_REQUEST_PROJECT_LABEL
field.query: SELECT p.id AS value, COALESCE(NULLIF(p.name, ''), CONCAT('ID ', p.id)) AS text FROM #__joomleague_project AS p INNER JOIN #__joomleague_competition AS c ON c.id = p.competition_id AND c.published = 1 INNER JOIN #__joomleague_season AS s ON s.id = p.season_id AND s.published = 1 INNER JOIN #__joomleague_sport_type AS st ON st.id = p.sport_type_id AND st.published = 1 WHERE p.published = 1 ORDER BY p.name, p.id

field.name: stage_id
field.label: COM_JOOMLEAGUE_BRACKET_REQUEST_STAGE_LABEL
field.query: SELECT s.id AS value, CONCAT(p.name, ' - ', s.name) AS text FROM #__joomleague_project_stage AS s INNER JOIN #__joomleague_project AS p ON p.id = s.project_id AND p.published = 1 WHERE s.published = 1 ORDER BY p.name, s.sequence_number, s.id
